description: This file defines the class RegistrationClientFactoryImpl, which implements the RegistrationClientFactory interface. It provides methods to create or retrieve registration clients for specific tenants within the Eclipse Hono framework, managing client lifecycle and event handling related to tenant timeouts.

classes.name: RegistrationClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing RegistrationClient instances associated with tenant IDs. It handles connection lifecycle events, tenant timeout messaging, and caching mechanisms within the Hono client framework.

methods.name: RegistrationClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a given HonoConnection and CacheProvider, and subscribes to tenant timeout events.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup actions when the connection is disconnected, specifically clearing client cache state.

methods.name: getOrCreateRegistrationClient
methods.description: Returns a Future that resolves to a RegistrationClient for the specified tenant ID, creating it if necessary, after verifying connection status.

methods.name: removeRegistrationClient
methods.description: Removes the registration client associated with the specified tenant ID from the cache.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages by closing and removing the corresponding registration client.
